text: Senior engineer requesting 5 consecutive days of annual paid time off (PTO) planned for next month, submitted 21 days in advance.
gold_policy_passage: All full-time employees accrue 20 days of Annual Leave per calendar year. Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least 2 weeks prior notice.

text: Employee requesting 25 days of annual leave in a single calendar year without prior accrued balance rollover.
gold_policy_passage: All full-time employees accrue 20 days of Annual Leave per calendar year.

text: Employee submitting planned 4-day annual leave starting in 3 days without prior notice or manager pre-approval.
gold_policy_passage: Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least 2 weeks prior notice and manager approval via the HR Portal.

text: Employee taking 2 days of sick leave due to seasonal flu, notified manager via email at 9:00 AM on the day of absence.
gold_policy_passage: Employees are granted 10 days of paid Sick Leave annually. In case of emergency or sudden illness, the employee must notify their direct reporting manager by 9:30 AM.

text: Employee taking 4 consecutive business days of sick leave but stating they did not visit a doctor and will not provide a medical certificate.
gold_policy_passage: For any consecutive medical absence lasting 3 or more business days, an official medical certificate from a licensed healthcare practitioner must be uploaded to the HR portal.

text: Employee requesting 14 days of paid sick leave in a single year, having already exhausted 8 days previously.
gold_policy_passage: Employees are granted 10 days of paid Sick Leave annually, credited on January 1 of each calendar year.

text: Full-time female employee with 200 days of service in the past 12 months applying for 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.
gold_policy_passage: Eligible female employees are entitled to 26 weeks (182 calendar days) of fully paid maternity leave for up to two surviving children. A minimum of 80 days of service is required.

text: Employee with only 30 days of service requesting 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.
gold_policy_passage: A minimum of 80 days of service in the preceding 12 months is required.

text: Employee requesting 4 days of bereavement leave following the demise of their mother (immediate family member).
gold_policy_passage: Employees may avail up to 5 consecutive business days of paid bereavement leave in the event of the demise of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling, or parent-in-law).

text: Employee requesting 4 days of paid bereavement leave for an extended family member (uncle).
gold_policy_passage: Up to 2 consecutive business days of paid leave are granted for extended family members (grandparents, aunts, uncles).

text: Employee claiming a compensatory off day for working on a critical weekend project 75 days ago without using it within the standard period.
gold_policy_passage: Comp-off must be utilized within 60 calendar days from the date worked; otherwise, it expires.

text: Remote employee submitting monthly home high-speed broadband claim of $45 USD with attached itemized service invoice.
gold_policy_passage: Employees working under a hybrid or remote contract are entitled to claim up to $50 USD per month for high-speed home broadband expenses with itemized billing statement.

text: Employee claiming $85 USD for monthly home internet allowance without special exception.
gold_policy_passage: Employees working under a hybrid or remote contract are entitled to claim up to $50 USD per month (or local currency equivalent) for high-speed home broadband expenses.

text: Employee with 40 days tenure claiming $280 USD for an ergonomic office chair with attached itemized store receipt.
gold_policy_passage: Full-time employees are eligible for a one-time $300 USD stipend upon hire to purchase approved ergonomic furniture. Claims must be filed within the first 90 days.

text: Employee submitting an expense claim incurred 70 calendar days ago along with valid original receipts.
gold_policy_passage: All expense claims must be filed within 30 calendar days of incurring the expense. Claims older than 60 days will be rejected automatically.

text: Employee claiming $40 USD for business travel meals without providing an original receipt.
gold_policy_passage: Original digital or scanned receipts are mandatory for all individual transactions exceeding $15 USD.

text: Full-time software engineer accepting paid weekend contracting work for a commercial fintech startup.
gold_policy_passage: Full-time employees are strictly prohibited from engaging in commercial secondary employment, consulting contracts, or board advisories.

text: Senior manager invited to deliver an unpaid academic guest lecture at a university with written disclosure submitted to Department VP and HR.
gold_policy_passage: Non-commercial, non-profit volunteer work or academic guest lectures are permissible provided written prior disclosure is approved by the Department Vice President and HR.

text: Employee requesting 12 days of annual leave without prior notice.
gold_policy_passage: Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least 2 weeks prior notice.

text: Employee taking 3 consecutive business days of sick leave with a medical certificate.
gold_policy_passage: For any consecutive medical absence lasting 3 or more business days, an official medical certificate must be uploaded.

text: Employee requesting 21 days of paternity leave.
gold_policy_passage: Paternity leave requested exceeds 4-week (20 working days) limit.

text: Employee claiming comp-off for working 50 days ago without prior manager approval.
gold_policy_passage: Comp-off claims require prior manager pre-approval before working on holiday or weekend.

text: Employee claiming $40 USD for home broadband without itemized billing.
gold_policy_passage: Employees working under a hybrid or remote contract are entitled to claim up to $50 USD per month for high-speed home broadband expenses with itemized billing statement.

text: Employee with 100 days tenure claiming $150 USD for an ergonomic chair.
gold_policy_passage: Claims must be filed within the first 90 days.

text: Employee claiming $20 USD for business travel meals without providing an original receipt.
gold_policy_passage: Original digital or scanned receipts are mandatory for all individual transactions exceeding $15 USD.

text: Employee booking 5 hour flight in business class.
gold_policy_passage: Flights under 6 hours require mandatory Economy class.

text: Employee submitting expense claim after 45 days.
gold_policy_passage: All expense claims must be filed within 30 calendar days of incurring the expense.

text: Employee accepting a $40 gift from a vendor without disclosing it to the Compliance Team.
gold_policy_passage: Activity complies with professional integrity and ethics guidelines.

text: Employee receiving a $10 Amazon gift card from a client.
gold_policy_passage: Cash or cash equivalents (gift cards, prepaid debit cards) of any amount are strictly prohibited.

text: Employee submitting a meal claim of $60 USD in a Tier 2 city.
gold_policy_passage: Daily meal expense exceeds Tier 2 per diem limit of $50 USD per day.
